end.summary: Practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting Pongal, Baisakhi, and Makar Sankranti with harvest time and seasonal crops. They shared that Diwali is their favourite and that they put up many lights at home. Kavya initially said festival dates were random; this was corrected later in the lesson, though the teach-back was not yet passed. At home, discuss one harvest festival and ask what crop, season, and harvest event it is connected to.
